preconditions.description: The number of cities n is between 2 and 200,000, inclusive.
Each city number u_i and v_i is between 1 and n, inclusive.
No city is directly connected to itself.

postconditions.description: The minimum number of days needed to repair all the roads is at least 1.
The minimum number of days needed to repair all the roads is at most n - 1.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= d_i <= n - 1 for d_i in days)
postconditions.description: Each day, the number of roads repaired d_i is between 1 and n - 1, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: sum(d_i for d_i in days) == n - 1
postconditions.description: The total number of roads repaired over all days equals n - 1.

postconditions.expression: all(all(1 <= road_i <= n - 1 for road_i in day) for day in days)
postconditions.description: Each road number in the output is between 1 and n - 1, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(all(u_road_i != v_road_i for u_road_i, v_road_i in zip(day[:-1], day[1:])) for day in days)
postconditions.description: No two roads in the same day are connected to the same pair of cities.

postconditions.expression: all(all(u_road_i in [u_i, v_i] and v_road_i in [u_i, v_i] for u_road_i, v_road_i in zip(day[:-1], day[1:])) for day in days)
postconditions.description: Each road in the output is one of the roads that connects the two cities it connects.
